value.definition: ACTIVATION declares itself Tier 1 owner of bounded work: steps and their transitions, intake, execution unit, admission, applicability/exclusion, output, configuration and delegation; context construction, size/fit/acquisition/activation/evaluation/staleness; refined results and disposition; totality, refinement, hard stops, licensing and approximation; work state/restart/accounts; cost, proportionality and resource limits; and closed results, invalidation and reuse. It uses, without redefining, FOUNDATIONS objects and core results and REFERENCE_FRAME frame objects and activate outcomes.

grounding.quote:
It uses
the objects of [FOUNDATIONS §2](FOUNDATIONS.md#2-ontology), the core result
algebra of [FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results), and the frame
object and the outcomes of `activate` of
[REFERENCE_FRAME](REFERENCE_FRAME.md) (§5). It defines the step-level
concepts it introduces, among them the current state, the destination,
the transition, the configuration, the execution unit, acquisition, the
rewrite step, the licensing law, the adequacy relation, the work state,
the actor's account, progress and churn, proportionality and the closed
result, and refines the
core for admission, activation and steps (§3); it redefines nothing those
members own.

value.label: ACTIVATION standard
